verified.label: Verified
verified.blurb: All chunks checksum-verified against the manifest.

scanning.label: Scanning
scanning.blurb: Re-hashing stored chunks and cross-checking the index.

issues.label: Issues found
issues.blurb: Some chunks failed verification — a rescan or repair is advised.

never.label: Never scanned
never.blurb: This repository hasn't been integrity-checked yet.

rescanStarted.title: Integrity scan started…
rescanStarted.description: Re-verifying every chunk in {{name}} against its manifest.

rescanFailed.title: Couldn't start the integrity scan
rescanFailed.description: {{name}} could not be scanned. Try again in a moment.

maintenanceOn.title: Maintenance mode on
maintenanceOn.description: {{name}} is read-only and jobs are paused while you service it.

maintenanceOff.title: Maintenance mode off
maintenanceOff.description: {{name}} is back online and accepting backups.

maintenanceFailed.title: Couldn't change maintenance mode
maintenanceFailed.description: {{name}}'s maintenance state was not updated. Try again.

card.threatLockedTitle: Sealed by threat response — holds restore points for {{names}}

detail.threatLockedBody: This repository holds restore points for {{names}}, currently under active threat investigation. The seal lifts automatically when the threat is contained or dismissed.
detail.noJobsTarget: No jobs currently target this repository.

failed.title: Couldn't add repository
failed.description: The appliance refused the request — check the path and capacity, then try again.

shareOffline.title: Repository added, but the share is offline
shareOffline.description: {{name}} — couldn't mount {{path}}. Check the host is reachable, the share exists, and the credentials are right.

added.title: Repository added
added.smbDedup: {{name}} — mounted, deduplicated, ready to receive backups.
added.smbDirect: {{name}} — mounted, direct (no dedup), ready to receive backups.

add.title: Add repository
add.description: Point AltaStor at storage you already own.
add.nameInvalid: Use up to 125 Latin letters, numbers, spaces, dots, underscores, or hyphens — starting with a letter or number.
add.credentialsNote: Used to mount the SMB/CIFS share. The password is stored in the appliance credential vault and never shown again.

deduplicated.title: Deduplicated
deduplicated.hint: Chunked + compressed on the share — saves space

direct.title: Direct
direct.hint: Whole files, no dedup — less CPU, faster restores

add.storageModeNote: Turn dedup off when the share is on a dedup appliance/NAS, or when faster restores and lower CPU matter more than space.

deleted.title: Repository deleted
deleted.description: {{name}} was removed. Its storage is released and no new backups can target it.

failed.title: Couldn't delete repository
failed.description: {{name}} could not be removed. Try again in a moment.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: Removing a repository releases its storage. This can't be undone.
delete.jobsBlock_one: <1>{{count}}</1> job still targets this repository — repoint or remove it first.
delete.jobsBlock_other: <1>{{count}}</1> jobs still target this repository — repoint or remove them first.
delete.jobsWarning_one: <1>{{count}}</1> job currently targets this repository. It will fail on the next run until re-pointed at another target.
delete.jobsWarning_other: <1>{{count}}</1> jobs currently target this repository. They will fail on the next run until re-pointed at another target.

failed.title: Couldn't save repository settings
failed.description: {{name}}'s changes were not applied. Try again in a moment.
